transformations: Exact-name selection from existing source objects
Single shared normalization, same as skin/skull/muscles of atlas
Exact Float32 deduplication only, no smoothing or retopology
limitations: Generic atlas, not a patient-specific vascular or nerve map
Named branch sets may be combined in one source object, notably facial nerve
Names translated for review, not clinical validation
Not all arteries or nerves of face represented
No vessel thickness, distance, depth or safe-injection-zone inference
Excluded inner-ear, kidney, brain nuclei and all unlisted objects; no invented branches
